requirement.original: Include schema file paths in agent prompts so agents produce schema-compliant output, eliminating post-hoc schema fix re-invocations
requirement.clarified: Add a schema self-validation instruction to each of the 6 parallel agent prompts in plan.md Step 8, and to the corresponding agent definition files, so agents validate their JSON output against the relevant schema before saving. This eliminates schema violations caught by validate-agent-outputs.py that currently require costly agent re-invocations.
requirement.what: Insert one instruction line per agent prompt (plan.md Step 8) and per agent definition file (.claude/agents/*.md) pointing to the absolute path of the agent's schema file, directing the agent to validate output before saving.
requirement.why: validate-agent-outputs.py in Step 9 frequently finds schema violations (e.g., accommodation null instead of object, transportation array instead of object) after parallel agents complete, forcing re-invocations that waste time and LLM budget.

included: plan.md Step 8 prompt blocks for all 6 parallel agents
Agent definition .md files for all 6 parallel agents
Schema path references using absolute paths
excluded: timeline-agent and budget-agent (serial, post-validation, not in scope)

success_criteria: Each of the 6 Step 8 prompts in plan.md contains a schema validation instruction before the Save to: line
Each of the 6 agent .md definition files contains a schema reference near the save instruction
No existing prompt fields altered (bilingual, GPS, return value requirements intact)
constraints: All 6 agents have Read tool available — no permission changes needed
Do not alter the Save to: line format
Use absolute paths only (agent working directory varies)
Transportation agent prompt still receives schema reference even though it only writes days with location_change

root_cause_analysis.symptom: validate-agent-outputs.py in Step 9 finds schema violations after parallel agents complete, requiring re-invocations (e.g., accommodation null instead of object, transportation array instead of object)
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: Agent prompts in Step 8 of plan.md do not reference the schema files in schemas/. Agents have no self-validation signal at write time and cannot detect structural violations before saving. Violations are only discovered post-hoc by the orchestrator's external validator.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause_commit: N/A — no single commit introduced this; it is a gap in prompt design, not a regression
root_cause_analysis.why_introduced: Schema files were added to define and validate output structure, but were not propagated back into the agent prompts that produce that output. The validation script was created as an external safety net rather than being paired with inline agent guidance.
root_cause_analysis.why_problematic: Agents producing structurally invalid JSON (wrong type for accommodation, wrong shape for transportation) must be re-invoked after Step 9 catches violations. Each re-invocation costs a full agent LLM call, adding latency to the plan workflow.
root_cause_analysis.timeline: Ongoing since schemas were introduced; no single commit marks the start

file_contents.agent_tools_available: All 6 agents have Read tool in their tools list — can read schema files without permission changes

development_approach.strategy: Insert a single schema validation instruction line into each of the 6 agent prompts in plan.md Step 8, immediately before the 'Save to:' directive. Use the same wording for all agents for consistency. Also insert the same instruction into each of the 6 agent definition .md files near the save step. Use absolute paths throughout.
development_approach.instruction_wording: Validate output against schema: /root/travel-planner/schemas/{agent}.schema.json before saving.
development_approach.insertion_point_plan_md: Immediately before the 'Save to: data/{destination-slug}/{agent}.json' line in each of the 6 Step 8 prompt blocks
development_approach.insertion_point_agent_md: Near the save instruction (scripts/save.py usage) in the Tasks section of each agent definition file
development_approach.validation_approach: After edits, grep plan.md for 'Validate output against schema' to confirm 6 occurrences. Grep each agent .md for the same string to confirm 1 occurrence each.

research_findings.reason: Straightforward prompt augmentation with clear root cause: agents lack schema path references. No novel pattern, no architecture decision needed. The fix is a mechanical insertion of known file paths into known prompt locations.
